message: You know those moments when you find yourself saying, "I told you so"? Well, I had one of those recently while prepping for family gatherings. I stumbled on a fantastic resource from the Red Cross about survival kits. It’s a gentle reminder that having the right supplies can keep us ready for anything life throws our way—just in case. It’s always good to be prepared, isn’t it? What’s your favorite go-to item in your emergency kit?
